entities.name: Vaash Vroga
entities.description: A Dominarian planeswalker who steals artifacts from many planes to feed her mantle of the Nightwalker.

entities.name: The Cabal
entities.description: A faction Vaash holds a deep grudge against.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker from whom Vaash stole an aetheric lens.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Ral's guildmaster, whose conversation Vaash overheard.

entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: A Zendikar character who turned Vaash away.

entities.name: Thada Adel
entities.description: A Zendikar character who traded the Khalni Seed to Vaash for artifacts.

entities.name: Khalni Seed
entities.description: An item Vaash took from Zendikar.

entities.name: Nani Oula
entities.description: The witch of the Moorlands who offered Vaash an apprenticeship.

entities.name: Lord Gavon Deniz
entities.description: A lord on Shiv who plotted to capture the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Keltaz
entities.description: A dragon of the brood of Kyashatar controlled by Vaash.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: A goblin killed by Vaash's saprolings who rose again.

entities.name: Khalila
entities.description: A geomancer of the Society of Mishra whose cerebral matrix Vaash stole.

entities.name: Mantle of the Nightwalker
entities.description: Vaash's mantle, which corrupted her before releasing Leshrac's soul.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: A soul tied to the mantle of the Nightwalker.

events.summary: Vaash steals Ral's aetheric lens and ambushes him on the Meditation Plane, escaping while he is distracted.
events.quote: Later, she ambushed Ral on the Meditation Plane and flaunted her success.

events.summary: Vaash trades foreign artifacts to Thada Adel for the Khalni Seed.
events.quote: the red-haired planeswalker left Zendikar with the Khalni Seed.

events.summary: Vaash takes Geralf's masterpiece body instead of delivering it to Nani Oula.
events.quote: she took the body instead of delivering it to Nani.

events.summary: On Shiv, Vaash uses a curiosity to control Keltaz, who kills Benalish soldiers, and kills Squee and other goblins.
events.quote: causing Keltaz to kill several Benalish soldiers.

events.summary: Vaash steals Khalila's cerebral matrix in the Crescent Shores caverns.
Vaash loses control of the mantle, which briefly corrupts her before releasing Leshrac's soul.
events.quote: she eventually lost control of the mantle and it briefly corrupted her before releasing Leshrac 's soul.

relations.quote: She holds a deep-seated grudge against The Cabal

relations.note: stole his lens and attacked him
relations.quote: just long enough for her to attack him and escape
she bargained with Lord Gavon Deniz in his plan to capture and activate the Mana Rig .
